title: Balanced classification (mock)
goal: Mock dataset (not empirical or user data). Trace an eight-tip topology without interpreting branch length as distance.

rubric.must: The four sister pairs A/B, C/D, E/F and G/H are preserved.
All eight named tips share a right-hand baseline, connected by slanted branches.
No quantitative distance scale is shown for this cladogram.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the phylo/slanted exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows all eight tips on a shared right-hand baseline, with traceable slanted branches preserving the A/B, C/D, E/F, and G/H sister pairs. It labels the figure as topology only and shows no quantitative distance scale.

items.evidence: The branching visibly pairs Species A with B, C with D, E with F, and G with H.
All eight named tips align at the same right-hand endpoint column and connect to the tree via slanted branches.
The note says branch lengths do not represent distance; no quantitative distance scale is shown.
